text: Seventy-three percent of respondents in a recent Gallup survey said they trust local news more than national news outlets. The survey, which polled 2,400 adults across all 50 states with a margin of error of plus or minus 2 percentage points, found that trust levels varied significantly by age group and political affiliation. Adults over 65 reported the highest trust in local news, while those aged 18 to 29 were more likely to rely on social media for news consumption. The researchers noted that the survey was conducted during a relatively calm news cycle, which may have influenced the results.
